name: Syed Modi International
stakes: This week offers India's emerging talent a prime opportunity to claim a Super 300 title on home turf, while Treesa & Gayatri aim to solidify their legacy with a historic hat-trick.
summary:
India's contingent at the Syed Modi International is making a strong push on home soil, particularly in the women's events. The spotlight is firmly on the women's singles, where a compelling all-Indian semifinal is set to unfold between the second seed Tanvi Sharma and rising star Unnati Hooda. Tanvi Sharma, after navigating a challenging path through the earlier rounds, will be looking to capitalize on her seeding and home advantage.

In women's doubles, top seeds Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand are continuing their impressive run, having secured a spot in the semifinals. They are now just two wins away from achieving a remarkable hat-trick of titles at this Super 300 event, a testament to their consistent performance. While the women's categories are buzzing with Indian success, the men's singles saw an early exit for HS Prannoy, who fell in the Round of 32. Other Indian hopefuls, like Tanvi Patri and the men's doubles pair of Arjun & Hariharan, faced tough draws or early exits, leaving the focus squarely on the semifinalists to carry the flag.
